lines: Nisaar main teri galiyon ke, ai watan, ki jahan
couplets.en: My homeland, I would give my life for your streets.

lines: Chali hai rasm ki koi na sar utha ke chale
couplets.en: Here, custom demands that everyone walk with bowed head.

lines: Jo koi chahne wala tawaaf ko nikle
couplets.en: A lover still ventures out to make the sacred round.

lines: Nazar chura ke chale, jism-o-jaan bacha ke chale
couplets.en: They must go with eyes averted, guarding life and limb.

lines: Hai ahl-e-dil ke liye ab ye nazm-e-bast-o-kushaad
couplets.en: For those who still have heart, this is the order of things.

lines: Ki sang-o-khisht muqayyad hain aur sag aazaad
couplets.en: Stones and bricks are held fast, while the dogs roam free.

lines: Bahut hai zulm ke dast-e-bahaana-ju ke liye
couplets.en: Tyranny needs little when it goes looking for a pretext.

lines: Jo chand ahl-e-junoon tere naam-lewa hain
couplets.en: A few impassioned souls still speak your name.

lines: Bane hain ahl-e-havas muddaai bhi, munsif bhi
couplets.en: The grasping have made themselves both accuser and judge.

lines: Kise wakeel karein, kis se munsifi chahein
couplets.en: Who will speak for us, and whom can we ask for justice?

lines: Magar guzaarne waalon ke din guzarte hain
couplets.en: Yet the days do pass for those who bear them.

lines: Tere firaaq mein yun subh-o-shaam karte hain
couplets.en: Apart from you, this is how we go from dawn to dusk.

lines: Bujha jo rauzan-e-zindaan to dil ye samjha hai
couplets.en: When the prison window went dark, the heart took it for a sign.

lines: Ki teri maang sitaaron se bhar gayi hogi
couplets.en: By now the parting in your hair must be full of stars.

lines: Chamak uthe hain salaas il to hum ne jaana hai
couplets.en: When the chains caught the light, we thought we knew why.

lines: Ki ab sahar tere rukh par bikhar gayi hogi
couplets.en: By now the dawn must have spilled across your face.

lines: Gharaz tasavvur-e-shaam-o-sahar mein jeete hain
couplets.en: And so we live on imagined dusks and dawns.

lines: Giraft-e-saaya-e-deewaar-o-dar mein jeete hain
couplets.en: We live held in the shadow of walls and doors.

lines: Ulajhti rahi hai zulm se khalq
couplets.en: The people have long grappled with tyranny.

lines: Na unki rasm nayi hai, na apni reet nayi
couplets.en: Their custom and ours are both old.

lines: Yunhi hamesha khilaaye hain hum ne aag mein phool
couplets.en: This is how we have always coaxed flowers from the fire.

lines: Na unki haar nayi hai, na apni jeet nayi
couplets.en: They have lost before, and we have won before.

lines: Isi sabab se falak ka gila nahin karte
couplets.en: For that reason, we bear the heavens no grievance.

lines: Tere firaaq mein hum dil bura nahin karte
couplets.en: Even apart from you, we do not lose heart.

lines: Gar aaj tujh se juda hain, to kal baham honge
couplets.en: Today we are apart, and tomorrow we will be together.

lines: Ye raat bhar ki judaai to koi baat nahin
couplets.en: A single night apart is little enough.

lines: Gar aaj auj pe hai taala-e-raqeeb, to kya
couplets.en: What if the rival's star is at its height today?

lines: Ye chaar din ki khudaai to koi baat nahin
couplets.en: A few days of playing god count for little.

lines: Jo tujh se ahd-e-wafa ustuwaar rakhte hain
couplets.en: Some still hold fast to their pledge to you.

lines: Ilaaj-e-gardish-e-lail-o-nahaar rakhte hain
couplets.en: They carry a remedy for the turns of night and day.

lines: Nisaar main teri galiyon ke, ai watan, ki jahan
couplets.en: My homeland, I would give my life for your streets.

lines: Chali hai rasm ki koi na sar utha ke chale
couplets.en: Here, custom demands that everyone walk with bowed head.
